english.title: Set glue trap in Wales likely to catch animal coming into contact with it
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) set in position in Wales a glue trap which was of such a nature and so placed as to be likely to catch any animal coming into contact with it
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 11(1)(bc) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

english.notes:
(i) Section 46 of the Agriculture (Wales) Act 2023 introduced this offence from the 17th October 2023.
(ii) See H101441 for the offence relating to 'use' of a glue trap.
(iii) Animal means a vertebrate (other than a human) - section 11(7ZA).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant set in position in Wales a glue trap which was of such a nature and so placed as to be likely to catch any animal coming into contact with it.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Where more than one animal is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each animal (section 21(5)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see section 20 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
